system.description:
Action R; Trigger You or an ally within 10 feet is targeted by an attack

The protective script upon your body flashes with sudden light. The target of the triggering attack gains a +1 status bonus to DB against that attack.

Use: target the creature being attacked (or nobody, for yourself); the +1 status bonus to DB is applied to them until the end of the current turn, the reaction is spent in combat, and the Focus use is spent (restored by Refocus).
